title: Former UAP Task Force Director Jay Stratton Reveals Government UFO Secrets
description:
Former U.S. UAP Task Force director Jay Stratton joins Jack Osbourne on Trying Not To Die to discuss his NY Times best selling memoir, 'Out of the Shadows', decades inside the intelligence community and his investigation into UFOs and non-human intelligence. Jay is the most senior U.S official to investigate UAP. He makes extraordinary claims about recovered craft, secret government programs, mysterious objects flying over nuclear facilities, and why he believes the public still hasn't been told the full story. He also recounts his experiences investigating Skinwalker Ranch, including strange aerial sightings, unexplained phenomena, and disturbing encounters that he says eventually affected his family. From Roswell and Area 51 to UFO disclosure and mysterious technology, this conversation explores some of the biggest unanswered questions surrounding the UAP phenomenon.
